text: A close-up, angled view of a laboratory storage rack with several horizontal metal shelf rails. Each rail holds a row of white label holders with purple corner blocks and small black-and-white square fiducial/QR-style markers. Labels carry Chinese text with English below: top row "Dragon skin 30 A", "Dragon skin 30 B", "Sylgard DC184 A", "Sylgard DC184 B", "Solaris Clear 40 A"; middle row "Mold 2", "Mold 3", plus a blank cream-coloured slab; lower row "...rown", "Sil-Pigment Green", "Sil-Pigment Black", "YMM-10-7". On the bottom shelf sit several white cylindrical containers, upright and closed with flat white lids; no liquid is visible. Metal thumbscrews protrude along the rails. Background wall is pale grey.
